newsitem.title: MALAYSIA: Malaysia CCM buys stake in US drug firm.
newsitem.headline: Malaysia CCM buys stake in US drug firm.

text.p: Chemical Co of Malaysia Bhd (CCM) said it has agreed to buy 10 percent of the share capital of U.S. firm Impax Pharmaceuticals Inc for $4 million.
In a statement issued late on Thursday, CCM said California-based, privately-held Impax is involved in the research and development of "new and unique dosage forms" of pharmaceutical products.
The acquisition would allow CCM, which has interests in chemical and pharmaceutical businesses, to expand its existing range of drug products.
CCM Pharma, a unit of CCM, has also signed a cross licencing agreement with Impax to conduct joint research and development programmes of pharmaceutical products, the statement said.
